mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the bending muscles was most worthwhile because the tendon explanation made clear why relaxing a muscle cannot push the bones back, and therefore why an opposing pull is needed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining cartilage and joint fluid felt less engaging as a decision because it was the only offered combination, although the result clearly explained their roles.

surprise.text: I was interested that opposing muscles can keep pulling without shortening while holding a weight still.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the offered combinations had purposes tied to building or stabilizing the joint.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the completed framework raises the question of how the opposing muscles are coordinated, though several steps here offered only one combination.
